template:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: hairstyle reference catalog, exactly one hairstyle presented as a horizontal 3-view triptych, landscape aspect ratio 3:2.
Use the attached h-001 image ONLY as the reference for mannequin material, background, lighting and three-column composition, not its haircut. NEW HAIRCUT: {{HAIR}}
Natural dark brown realistic individual hair fibers. Plain light gray matte adult mannequin bust with completely smooth featureless face: no eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, facial features or makeup. Keep anatomical ears, head, neck and gray crewneck shoulders. Warm light gray seamless studio background, even soft studio lighting, clean photorealistic wig catalog look.
Three EQUAL WIDTH columns: LEFT straight front view, CENTER exact right-facing 90-degree profile, RIGHT straight back view, same haircut same head at same scale in all views. Full hair silhouette visible with generous top and bottom margins. Keep each head entirely in its own third, never overlap neighboring columns. For long hairstyles show enough upper torso that every hair end fits without cropping; adjust camera distance consistently across all views. No lettering, numbers, watermark, collage labels, borders, decorative objects or accessories.
numberingNote: 原清单 h-002、h-003 分别改用 h-031、h-032，保留已入库的两款波波头。
